_comment: Verdicts for installed pi packages (entries of ~/.pi/agent/settings.json 'packages'). Prefixes: safe: / warn: / problem: — anything not listed here is reported as UNREVIEWED (warning). 'pi-web-bundled' applies to any path under pi-web's dist/pi-packages/ (ships with pi-web, tracked by the guard's drift check). Keep this file current: a new install is a new surface until it has a verdict here.

packages.npm:@99percentpeople/pi-ssh-remote: safe: the extension under lockdown (remote routing, fail-closed on transport loss)
packages.git:github.com/ronny-devbot/pi-ssh-remot: safe: glue for child-session inheritance; must stay listed BEFORE pi-ssh-remote
packages.pi-web-bundled: safe (class): pi-web's bundled pi-packages (relays, mcp-manager, session-naming, workflows, scheduled-tasks); mcp-manager is dormant without an mcp.json
packages.npm:pi-mono-web-search: problem: web_read can GET any public host = exfiltration channel for anything the model can read
packages.npm:pi-compaction-model: safe: settings/provider only, no model-facing tools
packages.git:github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail: safe: skills only, no tools; its ponytail-mcp subpackage is dormant without an mcp.json
packages.git:github.com/ronny-devbot/clone-sessio: warn: clone_session/clone_subsession — same trust as spawn (children inherit state); remove if you don't use it
packages.git:github.com/ronny-devbot/notify-ntfy: warn: model can push arbitrary text to your own ntfy
packages.npm:@99percentpeople/pi-background-tasks: problem (if installed): bg tools fall back to LOCAL execution in local sessions
